facts.text: Folwell is a neighborhood located in the northern part of Minneapolis, Minnesota.
Folwell Park hosts the Story Garden, a community space where residents gather to share stories and celebrate local heritage.
The Folwell Neighborhood Association works to connect residents and build intentional equity throughout the neighborhood.
Every Saturday and Sunday, the Folwell Neighborhood Association offers a free “Instrument Zoo” at Hopewell Music, letting kids explore musical instruments.
Neighborhood residents can join a free art workshop led by Liisa Le on Tuesday evenings, fostering creativity in the community.
Folwell’s Green Team runs community gardens and promotes environmentally conscious living, turning vacant lots into green spaces for residents.
